summary: Get tracks similar to a given track
description: Returns a list of tracks that are similar to the specified track ID. The similarity is based mainly on tags, then acoustic/electric features and other attributes. Optional filters can exclude tracks by the same artist or album. Results are sorted by a relevance score (0‑1). Pagination, formatting, and additional info can be controlled via query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with format=json or jsonpretty on GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' is capped at 200.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes the total number of matching rows in the header (results_fullcount). May impact performance.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Desired cover image size in pixels. If omitted, a default size is returned.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the 'audio' field. Defaults to mp31 (96 kbps) if not specified.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field. If omitted, inherits 'audioformat', otherwise defaults to mp32.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma‑separated list of additional fields to include in each result.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the track for which similar tracks are requested.

parameters.name: no_artist
parameters.description: Artist ID to exclude tracks by this artist from the results.

parameters.name: no_album
parameters.description: Album ID to exclude tracks from this album from the results.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, warnings, and results_count.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of similar track objects. Each object contains fields such as id, name, artist_name, score, and optional included data.

notes: Both client_id and id parameters are mandatory.
The 'no_artist' and 'no_album' filters are useful to avoid returning tracks from the same artist or album.
The maximum effective limit is 200 even when using the 'all' keyword.
The 'include' parameter accepts multiple comma‑separated values; each adds extra fields to each track object.
If 'audiodlformat' is omitted, it follows the value of 'audioformat'; if both are omitted, default download format is mp32.
